decisions.reason: The customer-provided bullet visual reference changes bullet appearance, not Tab-based sublevel input, hierarchy behavior, or nested-list alignment.
The bullet visual reference does not change the required stability or predictability of transferring content from legacy templates.
The bullet-list design reference does not affect pasted-table structure, column containment, or the existing feasibility conflict.
The visual design of bullets does not change the requirement that template style names use Danish.
The bullet-list visual reference does not change the document default-language configuration.
